You have been issued a compass. Press 1 to hold it up, then turn until you are facing the sun. When the sun is in the north of the sky, you are in the planet's southern hemisphere. When it is in the south of the sky, you are in the northern hemisphere. When it is hidden by cloud, you are, in the technical sense, fu**ed. Today's sky has been cleared for you at considerable expense. Don't forget, the red needle points north, some trainees needed this to be explained not to name any names … Frank.
